feature_name: Local Docker Build and Run Commands
description: Add new experimental commands to the Shuttle CLI that allow building and running projects using Docker locally, matching the platform's build pipeline. This enables developers to debug the platform's build system and runtime environment on their local machines. Also add shorthand command aliases for common operations to improve developer ergonomics.
functional_requirements: Implement a `shuttle build` command that builds the runtime natively with cargo build, supporting --release and --bacon flags
Implement a `shuttle build --docker` command that uses the same archiving and Dockerfile pipeline as the deployment platform, with support for custom image tags
Implement an experimental `shuttle run --docker` command that performs a local Docker build followed by docker run for runtime environment debugging
Add shorthand command aliases: 'shuttle i' for init, 'shuttle b' for build, 'shuttle r' for run, and 'shuttle d' for deploy
Improve CLI output formatting to match cargo's style for packing, uploading, and building operations
Ensure all experimental commands display appropriate warnings about their experimental status
